cmd:
cat > /tmp/_dirty_check.sh << 'SCRIPTEOF'
#!/bin/sh
cd /opt/weather-pipeline/repo || exit 1
echo "=== git status --short ==="
git status --short
echo "=== git diff --name-status (unstaged) ==="
git diff --name-status
echo "=== git diff --stat (unstaged) ==="
git diff --stat
echo "=== git diff --cached --name-status (staged) ==="
git diff --cached --name-status
echo "=== rev-list --count origin/main..HEAD ==="
git rev-list --count origin/main..HEAD
echo "=== mtimes of changed tracked files ==="
for f in $(git status --short | awk "{print \$2}"); do
  stat -c "%Y  %y  %n" "$f" 2>/dev/null
done
echo "=== now ==="
date -u +%s
date -u

SCRIPTEOF
chmod +x /tmp/_dirty_check.sh && flock -w 60 /tmp/vps_git.lock /tmp/_dirty_check.sh
